title: Melting Pair
description: Draw two white circles that melt into each other with a smooth neck, on a black background. Both have radius 0.35. One is centered at (-0.35, 0.0) and the other at (0.35, 0.0). Join them with a polynomial smooth minimum with a blend width of 0.3. The canvas runs from -1 to 1 in both directions.
